display_long_description:
Become the Ultimate Blade Master in VR!

Step into a medieval dungeon and put your throwing skills to the test with VR Knife Hit. This addictive arcade-style game brings the thrill of precision knife throwing to your Meta Quest. Your objective is simple: throw your knives into the rotating logs to break them, but be careful—hitting your own knives will end your run!

Why You’ll Love VR Knife Hit:
Arcade Precision: Experience satisfying physics-based throwing mechanics. Time your shots perfectly as the targets speed up and change direction.

Epic Boss Battles: Every 5th stage is a Boss Fight! Defeat unique rotating bosses to earn exclusive, legendary knives.

Unlock a Massive Armory: Slice juicy apples to earn points and unlock over 20+ unique blade designs—from classic daggers to glowing enchanted swords.

Atmospheric Dungeon Setting: Immerse yourself in a high-quality 3D environment with torch-lit halls and immersive sound effects that react to every hit.

Infinite Challenge: How far can you go? Compete with yourself to break your high score and climb through increasingly difficult stages.

Sharpen your focus, steady your hand, and prepare for the most addictive throwing game in VR. Download VR Knife Hit today and see if you have what it takes to defeat the boss!
